verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev ships an official MCP server (docs + verified runtime handshake) that lets AI assistants interact with projects, plus agent skills and MCP tools for chatting with agents from Claude Code/Cursor/Windsurf, which enables natural-language operation via an AI assistant intermediary. However, there's no evidence of a native NL command interface within Trigger.dev's own dashboard/CLI itself — the capability is mediated entirely through third-party AI coding tools connecting via MCP, not a first-party conversational UI. missing for 10: evidence of a built-in natural-language command surface (chat/prompt box) in the Trigger.dev product itself, independent/hands-on validation of the MCP-driven NL workflow beyond docs and protocol handshake.
